meta_description:
45K likes, 2,417 comments - prernachhabra on November 2, 2024: "Last Sunday morning we welcomed a baby girl 💕🥰😇🙏🏻

The entire process of delivery and labour pains had me wondering - “how have women been doing it and that too multiple times” 🥹🥲

Anyhow now that we’ve made it to the other side of the finish line (yes it does feel like that 😅) the excitement is such that the sleepless nights aren’t bothering me for now 😄🥹

It feels surreal to see a tiny human in my hands and to think she came out of me 🥹🥹🥹🥹 the heart is full of gratitude and only gratitude. Thank you for all your kind wishes and blessings 😇❤️🙏🏻🧿

#prernachhabra #pregnancydiaries #blessed #grateful #stylinginspirations #newborn #newmom".
